title: Revamp interactive elevation tokens and fluid radius for dense data components
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: introduce a compact, accessible set of elevation and corner-radius tokens that adapt across density modes (comfortable / compact / dense) and clarify interactive states for tables, buttons, and chart overlays. This ticket covers the token definitions, naming conventions, Figma token files, CSS variable mappings, and handoff guidance for engineering. Background: current elevation matrix is coarse and doesn't provide subtle layering for inner table rows, dropdowns, and floating chart tooltips. Radius scale is flat across components which causes visual imbalance at small sizes. This work should reduce perceived visual clutter in dense UIs while maintaining contrast and focus cues for interactive elements.
acceptance_criteria: A documented token spec (color, elevation, radius) published in the design tokens Figma and Confluence pages
Three density modes (comfortable / compact / dense) with clear numeric mappings for spacing and radius
Elevation micro-ramps (at least 4 steps) with example applications: table rows, row hover, dropdown surface, chart tooltip, modal surface
Tokens exported as CSS custom properties and validated by ENG runtime team with a reference stylesheet
Accessibility check: all interactive surface contrasts meet AA for text and boundary visibility where required
Migration notes for existing components and a deprecation window for legacy tokens
notes: 2025-11-18 — Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes: aligned with PM on scope; prioritize tables and chart overlays for Q1 rollout. Agreed to separate token spec from component implementation to enable parallel work streams.
2025-11-22 — Luca Moreno: Exploratory Figma frames added showing dense table with reduced radius and micro-elevation on hover. Early feedback: need stronger hover highlight for keyboard focus states.

2025-11-27 — Accessibility review (Sara Klein): Suggested elevating boundary contrast for dense rows and ensuring focus outlines remain 2px minimum for keyboard nav. Recommended running automated color contrast checks on exported token palettes.

2025-11-30 — PM sync (Jonah Kim): Confirmed release alignment with release-2026.01 and dependency on ENG-4122 (style variables infra). Jonah requested migration strategy to avoid breaking changes for Dedicated customers.

2025-12-02 — Design review: Decision to add two new elevation families: surface-elev (global surfaces) and micro-elev (intra-component micro-layers). Renamed tokens to use alias pattern: --rw-surface-elev-01 / --rw-micro-elev-01 for clarity.

2025-12-03 — Implementation note (Luca): Draft CSS variables added to reference stylesheet in PR #1427. Included media-query breakpoint for compact density where radius scales down by 12.5% and spacing tokens shift by -2px. Working with ENG to toggle density via data-density attribute.

2025-12-04 — Review feedback from frontend (Marisol R.): PR changes: reduce shadow blur on micro-elev-02 to 6px (from 10px) for better readability on 2x scaled displays. Also suggested adding a token alias for focus-ring to decouple from elevation tokens.
Follow-ups: run visual diff suite on table regressions, create migration playbook for private customers, and schedule 1:1 with Platform Eng to confirm rollout automation for CSS token flips.
